description:
Search domains registered in the last three days from a live feed covering all TLDs, including country-code ones such as .ai and .io. Returns exact registration and expiry timestamps plus the name split into words; names usually appear within minutes of registration. Use nrds instead for history beyond three days, for registration-term or for-sale filters, for the cross-TLD count, or for deeper paging. nrds carries most of the same recent names, but with day-level dates and a 60-day history that is gTLD-based.

Related tools: nrds, whois, dns, typosquat

keyword.description: Search term, 2-64 characters, letters/digits/hyphens only. Matches anywhere in the name unless position is set.

page.description: Page number for pagination. The live feed pages through the first 10000 matches; narrow the filters to reach beyond that.

position.description: Keyword placement in domain name. Default is 'all' (substring match). Requires keyword.

sort.description: Sort order. Default is reg_date_desc (most recent first).

tld.description: Filter by a single TLD (e.g., 'com', 'ai', 'io'). One TLD per call; omit to cover all TLDs.

name: nrds_live

components.description: Word segmentation of the name, space-separated. Absent when the feed supplies none.

expiry_date.description: Expiry timestamp; the gap from registered_date is the registration term

length.description: Character length of the name before the TLD

registered_date.description: Registration timestamp as supplied by the live feed

error.description: Error message when success is false

total.description: Number of results on this page

total_found.description: Total matching results across all pages

title: Live Newly Registered Domains
